title: radius-desktop.json
description: Attached to every desktop-v* GitHub release. The radius CLI reads it to download, verify and install the desktop app. A platform that is absent has no build in that release.

version.description: The app version, equal to the release tag without its desktop-v prefix.

agentNoteVersions.description: The development agent descriptor schemaVersion values this build reads.

platforms.description: Keyed by OCI-style os/arch, as the CLI's hostPlatformKey produces.

artifact.description: An archive that unpacks without an installer: a zip holding Radius.app on macOS, a zip of the unpacked app on Windows, an AppImage on Linux.
